purpose: Write and build every course and YouTube video the one fixed way: about 15 min of narrated slides, the switch ("Now watch my screen"), build rounds (real work on the left, an animated teacher/AI chat on the right, one continuous recording per round), a skill file, the wrap, the finished work and the ONE shared end screen that every video ends with (no episode label anywhere). Voice: one locked, repeatable TTS clone preset.
cost_flags: Voice is free (local clone on CPU or GPU); heavy GPU steps only when the machine is free
owner_approval: GPU use for voice and tool recordings
sending the finished video to the owner (main session relay); nothing is published
evaluation: The lesson builder's script and slides stages run with no OVERFLOW; the timeline puts the slide part at 13-16 min before the switch slide; every build-round chat line matches its real recording; master.mp4 and share.mp4 (under 9 MB) have one video and one audio stream; privacy grep clean; the last slide is the shared end screen; no caption cue overlaps a film or a sound hold; no lesson label when meta.no_label is set.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Python + ffmpeg + Playwright/Edge; a local TTS clone worker; node-tool and terminal recorders.
